story_type: long-range Bering Sea hoist from a 147-foot fishing vessel underway, filmed from a second aircraft
hook: Far out in the Bering Sea, a Jayhawk came for one man.
narration: Far out in the Bering Sea, a Coast Guard Jayhawk hovered over a fishing boat pushing through whitecaps.
A sixty three year old crewman aboard the Blue Attu needed to get to a hospital.
The one hundred forty seven foot boat was working north of St. Paul Island, a long way from anywhere.
Over a moving boat, the pilot matches its speed while the hoist operator talks him into position, one foot at a time.
Then the crew hoisted the man up into the helicopter.
outcome: The Kodiak aircrew flew him to St. Paul for a flight on to Anchorage.
title: Bering Sea hoist off a 147-foot boat
description:
A Coast Guard Air Station Kodiak MH-60 Jayhawk crew hoisted a 63-year-old crew member from the 147-foot fishing vessel Blue Attu north of St. Paul, Alaska, on Nov. 18, 2018, and flew him to St. Paul for transport to Anchorage.
